item.title: Peregrine Falcon Nesting Platform Approved For Symington Building
item.description: The green light has been given for a new peregrine falcon nesting platform on the Symington Building in Market Harborough. Harborough District Council’s aim is to have it ready before next year’s breeding season, providing a safer, more sheltered spot for a pair of birds that have previously attempted to nest on the nearby church. item.title: LCC Council Tax Rise Likely
item.description: Residents look set to pay more for services provided by Leicestershire County Council next year. item.title: Appeal After ATM Stolen In Ram-Raid
item.description: Police are appealing for witnesses after a ram-raid in Brixworth early this morning. Thieves used a bronze Nissan Navara pick-up truck to drive into the front of the Co-Op on Harborough Road at 1.10am, before stealing the cash machine. item.title: Warning To Sellers Over Rise In Counterfeit Cash
item.description: Leicestershire Police are urging people to check bank notes when selling items online after a rise in counterfeit cash. Fifteen incidents have been reported in the last month, including in the Lutterworth area, mainly involving high-value phones sold on Facebook Marketplace.
